metadata.title: [Perf][SM70][DeepSeek-V4] Tile live packed decode index scoring
metadata.body:
Contributed by PLI Labs (Proprietary Legal Intelligence). Written with AI assistance (Claude Code) and reviewed in three rounds before opening. Independent of our other DeepSeek-V4.1 PRs: it applies to `main` alone and keeps main's TP4/PP1 admission.

## Purpose

Stage queries and packed keys once per tile while retaining the public #1277 scorer's FMA, FP16 rounding and head-sum order. The live key limit is clamped to allocation capacity. Unsupported head counts, hardware, missing operations and ABI mismatch refuse at model construction.

The separate optional extension keeps this experiment independently buildable without rebuilding or changing the large v41k ABI. Its source, build target, Meta implementation and explicit installed-package library path are included. This trades a second library for a bounded opt-in native change; folding it into v41k remains a packaging option after GPU qualification. It extends the packed V4.1 route, rather than #1222's V4 cuBLAS indexer.

## Test Plan

```bash
python -m tools.generate_architecture_reference --check
python -m tools.generate_env_reference --check
python tools/pre_commit/check_env_metadata.py
python tools/pre_commit/check_env_registration.py
python -m tools.config_inventory --check
python tools/pre_commit/check_layering.py
```

```bash
python -m pytest -q --confcutdir=tests/config tests/config/test_v41_index_tiled_policy.py tests/config/test_flash_v100_lifecycle.py tests/config/test_runtime_default_ownership.py tests/config/test_sm70_native_runtime.py
python -m pytest -q --confcutdir=tests/tools tests/tools/test_architecture_reference.py tests/tools/test_architecture_doc_urls.py tests/tools/test_architecture_check_scope.py
python -m pytest -q --confcutdir=tests/models tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_index_tiled.py
(
cd benchmarks/deepseek_v41/v41idx
nvcc -std=c++17 -O2 -DV41IDX_HOST_TEST v41idx_host_test.cu -o host-check
./host-check
./host-check --capacity-only
nvcc -std=c++17 -O2 -DV41IDX_HOST_TEST -DV41IDX_MUTANT_ORDER v41idx_host_test.cu -o mutant-check
./mutant-check --expect-mismatch
)
```

On an SM70 GPU, build with `python benchmarks/deepseek_v41/v41idx/build.py`, then run `python benchmarks/deepseek_v41/v41idx/check_v41idx.py --lib "$INDEX_LIBRARY" --v41k "$V41K" --no-time` for its correctness/capture matrix against the compatible reference library. Qualify the public TP4/PP1 model before timing; the historical PP2 integration is not in this branch. Use the following serving command once per disabled/enabled arm, with CHECKPOINT naming a compatible V4.1 checkpoint and the two library variables naming the built files:

```bash
VLLM_V41_PACKED_KV=1 VLLM_V41K_LIB="$V41K" \
VLLM_V41_INDEX_TILED="$ENABLED" VLLM_V41_INDEX_TILED_LIB="$INDEX_LIBRARY" \
  vllm serve "$CHECKPOINT" --tensor-parallel-size 4 --pipeline-parallel-size 1 \
  --max-num-seqs 1 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --no-async-scheduling \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":5}'
```

Warm both greedy and seeded sampled requests, then use disabled/enabled/enabled/disabled arms at short, 150K and 300K context where checkpoint capacity permits. Record native operator hits, bitwise scores and selected indices, complete output token IDs, first-token latency, decode-only milliseconds per verification round and acceptance separately. Run sanitizer checks and capture/replay with changed positions, including stale positions beyond capacity. Missing execution or quality evidence is inconclusive.

## Path coverage

| Path / provider | Format | Key conditions (shape, TP/EP, graph, capability) | Expected selection / fallback | Evidence (source / static / executed / measured) | Unverified scope |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tiled packed decode | FP16 queries/weights, packed FP4 index keys | SM70, 1..64 query-head rows; TP4 model currently yields eight heads/rank | Explicit enabled scorer; construction refuses unsupported heads/library/device; capacity clamps stale live end | Executed: CPU kernel bodies, dispatch/admission tests, and on this branch the SM70 build plus bitwise GPU matrix and graph replay; measured: serving on the #1277 build | Meta, sanitizer and serving on this branch |
| Four-head native specialization | Same | Native scorer supports four heads; current model's 32/4 heads path yields eight | Available to native tests; not claimed reachable in current model | Host oracle | A qualified four-head model path |
| Disabled / prefill | Existing formats | OFF or more than 64 query-head rows | Existing v41k/Triton or prefill route | CPU adapter dispatch and policy checks | GPU parity |
| Other models | All | Scorer never bound | Inactive policy omitted from effective hash | CPU config tests | No speed claim |

## Acceleration and benchmark contract (required for performance changes)

- Default enabled or opt-in: Opt-in through attention_config.v41_index_tiled.enabled or VLLM_V41_INDEX_TILED=1.
- Required CLI options and environment switches: Packed V4.1 KV, SM70, existing TP4/PP1 model admission, compatible v41k and optional v41idx libraries. Set VLLM_V41_INDEX_TILED_LIB explicitly in installed packages.
- KV cache dtype used for the benchmark: Historical #1277 packed V4.1 format; not fp8_ds_mla.
- Wheel SHA or source commit: This branch: rebased onto `main` `3c051b52e`. The speed numbers were measured on our build of the #1277 merge (`899e9ed33`) with the PP2 x TP4 port (#1370); the bitwise GPU check below ran on this branch.
- PYTHONPATH, source overlays, or external native libraries used (write "none" if absent): Historical measurements included unpublished PP2 model changes and native libraries. This branch contains v41idx source and no binary. The source-checkout default is benchmarks/deepseek_v41/v41idx/build/v41idx.so.
- User-entry route-hit, speed, and output-quality evidence: MEASURED 2026-11-04 (table under Test Result): 150K -7.0 %, 300K -13.7 % ms per round, identical output; short context not detectable. Reproducing them needs the PP2 port (#1370) and a GGUF hybrid checkpoint; no speed claim is made for `main` alone.
- Existing kernel/backend registry and capability-rejection reasons: Attention-owned scorer, required-op and ABI checks; no MoE priority change. Native checks validate shape/dtype/row count/output capacity.
- Per-engine configuration and deprecated-variable compatibility: Existing ExecutionPolicy under AttentionConfig, captured before execution and serialized; explicit typed choice wins, empty flag OFF. Model construction binds the effective policy before graph-key creation.
- New/changed environment metadata and generated reference check: Two experimental aliases registered. Environment and architecture reference, metadata, registration and ownership gates rerun.
- Route snapshot command and intentional changed rows (write "none" for refactors): python -m tools.sm70_route_snapshot --category moe --output /dev/stdout; compare with main. No intentional MoE changes; this cannot establish scorer execution.
- SM70 registered variables / unregistered reads / model-parameter restrictions, before -> after: SM70-named count unchanged; two V41 aliases added; no new unregistered reads. V4.1 packed/SM70 and existing topology restrictions remain.

## Test Result

**MEASURED, 2026-11-04,** 8x V100-SXM2-32GB, PP2 x TP4 (#1370), one request, DSpark 5, paired arms OFF ON ON OFF, decode ms per verify round:

| context | OFF | ON | change | pairs (ON - OFF) | A/A (OFF2 - OFF) | output |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 150,000 tokens | 29.98 | 27.88 | -7.0 % | -2.10 / -1.73 | +0.08 | identical, 139 rounds every arm |
| 300,000 tokens | 34.33 | 29.62 | -13.7 % | -4.71 / -4.57 | +0.10 | identical, 89 rounds every arm |
| short (T=0 and T=1) | - | - | +0.032 ms average | +0.067, +0.069, -0.006, -0.001 | - | identical; not detectable |

**Re-run on `main` for this PR, 2026-11-05,** branch rebased onto `3c051b52e`:

- GPU, one V100-SXM2-32GB (SM70), `v41k.so` and `v41idx.so` built from this branch with `build.py`: `check_v41idx.py --no-time` -> `ALL OK (53972 cases)`: the matrix (53,952 cases, 3.8e9 values written) and the CUDA-graph replays with changed positions, including stale live ends past capacity, are bitwise equal to the reference `v41k` scorer; 0 mismatched cases.
- Host oracle (`v41idx_host_test.cu`, nvcc): 8,640 cases, 0 mismatches; `--capacity-only` OK; the reversed-order mutant is detected (330 values in 277 cases).
- CPU pytest, the eight test files in the plan: 73 passed, 10 failed. The 10 failures are all in `tests/config/test_runtime_default_ownership.py` and fail identically on unmodified `main` (`SimpleNamespace` has no attribute `model`).
- `generate_env_reference --check`, `config_inventory --check`, `check_env_metadata.py`, `check_env_registration.py`, `generate_architecture_reference --check`: all pass. `check_layering.py` output is identical to `main` (its existing `fused_moe.py` and `moe_runner.py` findings).
- ruff 0.14.0 `check` and `format --check` on the 10 changed Python files: pass.

Not re-run on `main`: compute-sanitizer, the `TIME` lines of the checker, and serving. The numbers in the table were not re-measured on this branch.

---
